name: li_gg_emepmupmum_cms
madloop_process: g g > e+ e- mu+ mu- [sqrvirt=QCD]
recola_process: g g -> e+ e- mu+ mu-

scheme_data.description: The ew-gmu values under MG5's complex-mass scheme (set complex_mass_scheme True) on the default restriction: complex masses sqrt(M^2 - i M Gamma) for t, Z, W, H at the card widths of restrict_default.dat (WT = 1.37758, WZ = 2.49877, WW = 2.09291, WH = 0.00407468); a process with an external unstable multiplet sets its width to 0 (parameter_overrides). Under CMS MG5 removes the YUKAWA inputs (ymX := the complex mass), so no Yukawa is set.

conventions.GfRedefinitionChoice: 1 (fixed by the restriction card: alpha_Gmu = sqrt(2) Gf |mu_W^2 (1 - mu_W^2/mu_Z^2)| / pi)
conventions.ghost_widths: zero (the UFO's ghosts carry no width; MadLoop's loop denominators use the complex mass)

normalization.convention: |A_loop|^2 summed over final and averaged over initial helicities and colours, with the final identical-particle factor; physical couplings

point_construction.construction: tools/loop_reference/exact_points.py: deterministic exact terminating-decimal sequential construction; mass shells and momentum conservation exact

rule: PLAN §4.0 L1: provider agreement <= 1e-05 relative (lax); digits recorded

madloop.timing_scope: single thread pinned; untimed warm-up (MadLoop: past its initialisation), then each point timed once; not a benchmark campaign

fortran_flags.source: MG5_aMC run-card defaults global_flag/aloha_flag/matrix_flag (CommonRunCmd.update_make_opts of an optimised MG5 run); MadLoop's own makefile adds -O3 for polynomial.f

mg5_quadruple_precision_model_function_r: added KIND=16 to 19 CMPLX calls in MP_ functions
settings.warm_up: untimed calls cycling through the points until MadLoop leaves its initialisation phase, at least CheckCycle + 1 = 4

generation.command: g g > e+ e- mu+ mu- [sqrvirt=QCD]
generation.process: Process: g g > e+ e- mu+ mu- [ sqrvirt = QCD ]

madloop.per_helicity_normalization: value = |A(h)|^2/avg (the summed convention's divisor, PLAN Q39) = MadLoop's USERHEL value (SLOOPMATRIXHEL_THRES: colour average and identical factor, no helicity average) / HELAVGFACTOR; helicity labels in MadLoop's HelConfigs.dat convention

recola.timing_scope: single thread pinned; untimed warm-up (MadLoop: past its initialisation), then each point timed once; not a benchmark campaign
